page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with Hebrew letters and a Latin commentary set beside them at the left; no margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: dio, ב profertur ut b durum: sine Dages ב ut b molle seu aspiratum.
ג Gimel cū Dages ג g: sine Dages ג gh.
ד Daleth cum Dages ד d: sine Dages ד dh.
ו Vau sonat fere ut f: sed nō ita aspiratur.
ז Zain est ẓ lene vel dz.
ח Heth aspiratio fortis h vel ch.
י Iod sonat sicut j in jehova.
כ Caph cum Dages ך: sine Dages כ. In fine signatur sic ך.
מ Mem est m. In fine signatur sic ם vel sic ם.
נ Nun est n. In fine scribitur sic ן.
ע Ajin sonat prout habet additam vocalem. Iudæi efferunt gargarismo tanquam g.

page.notes: Hebrew letters and points are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the Hebrew forms and some final-letter shapes are doubtful, especially the Dages and the final forms of כ, מ and נ. The Hebrew letter immediately before "Pe" at the foot is printed as a catchword-like heading and is shown as a paragraph. The Hebrew glyphs in the Latin lines are approximated and should be checked against the scan.
